subject: general
question: Which of the following articles of the Indian Constitution mentions the fundamental duty to safeguard public property and to abjure violence"?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 51A(i)**____**.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51A **of the Indian Constitution lays down the **fundamental duties** of every citizen of India. 
 
• **Article 51A (i)** states that it shall be the duty of every citizen of India to** safeguard public property** and to **abjure violence.**
 
• This duty is important to maintain law and order in the country and to ensure that public property is** not damaged or destroyed **by any individual or group.
 
• The duty to** abjure violence** means that citizens should refrain from any kind of violent activities that may harm others or cause **damage to public property.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 51A (g)** mentions the duty of every citizen of India to protect and improve the natural environment including **forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife,** and to have compassion for living creatures.

 
 
• This duty emphasizes the** importance of environmental protection **and **animal welfare.**
 
 
 
• **Article 51A (a) **mentions the duty of every citizen of India to **abide by the Constitution** and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag, and the National Anthem.
 
 
• This duty emphasizes the** importance of patriotism and respect **for national symbols.
 
 
 
• **Article 51A (d)** mentions the duty of every citizen of India to promote** harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood **amongst all the people of India, transcending religious, linguistic, and regional or sectional diversities.
 
 
• This duty emphasizes the importance of **communal harmony and national integration.**
